description: Source code for a Go package 'journal' providing write bindings to the systemd journal, including functions for checking journal availability, sending log messages, and interacting with journal streams.

methods.name: Enabled
methods.description: Checks whether the local systemd journal is available for logging.

methods.name: StderrIsJournalStream
methods.description: Checks if stderr is connected to the Journal's stream transport.

methods.name: StdoutIsJournalStream
methods.description: Checks if stdout is connected to the Journal's stream transport.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Sends a message to the local systemd journal with specified priority and variables.
